_comment: Snapshot of OpenCode Go's published model -> endpoint table. This is an ORACLE: it records what the PROVIDER publishes, not what kitty routes. tests/test_opencode_endpoint_table.py asserts the two agree. Refreshing it is a human act - see refresh_procedure.
probe_note: No live routing probe backs this table. An unauthenticated POST to both /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions with model 'qwen3.8-max' (2026-09-11) returned 401 {"type":"AuthError","message":"Missing API key."} from each: auth is evaluated before dialect, so an unkeyed probe cannot distinguish the routes. A holder of a paid key can add real evidence by posting a minimal body to each endpoint for one model per route and recording which combination is accepted; do that and record the result here.
models_endpoint_is_not_an_oracle: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models is public but returns model ids only, with no endpoint, and still lists retired aliases (glm-5, kimi-k2.5, mimo-v2-pro, mimo-v2-omni, grok-4.5, qwen3.5-plus, deepseek-flash, hy3-preview, omen-alpha). Do not build the routing guard on it.
refresh_procedure: Re-read the Endpoints table at source_url, replace `models` wholesale, set verified_utc, and run `pytest -m l2 tests/test_opencode_endpoint_table.py`. A model added here without a matching change to _MESSAGES_MODELS / _RESPONSES_MODELS in src/kitty/providers/opencode.py fails that guard by design.
